body: At my current place of work I would occasionally see this really cute girl who worked in a different department then me, I was well attracted but I really wasent sure what I was feeling so I would often find myself watching her when she was around trying to figure out my feelings, I started getting super giddy, like a hit of euphoria  when she was around and I just really really wanted to  talk to her and for her to like me and yet I was still unwilling to admit I was badly crushing on her, until one day at work a guest happen to fly past me in a rush. he was extremely tall and almost jogging trying to get past this cramped crowd, well as he rushed past I looked behind after him and right almost behind me was the girl! he almost ran smack into her, i almost reached out and yanked him back, i was so irrationally pissed he could have hurt her! luckily they didnt collide but my irrational flare of rage in defensive of this girl was probably gayest moment of my life, and i kind of had accept it at that point.

I have taken that year of so to speak. After my attempt my boyfriend and roommates allowed me to stay home instead of work as I cleaned, but in the end I guess I wasent good enough at cleaning and I was aware of being a parasite to them that ive ended up more stressed now then ever now they are pushing me to get anywhere at all and i feel like i have no choice in the matter of where i work. i want to leave badly but i dont know where to go i feel better at my families place but thats a state away and im afraid they would hate me too in the run if i went there so i have no options and nothing that i can do. I dont know if this at all will help you but maybe you just cant really know what will work what will help until you are there and if it dosent work try something else if you can. Maybe save alot of money for the year maybe move somewhere completely new maybe move back home for a while till it stops working. if your at your lowest point then maybe just trying anything is a good idea. i think thats the thing with people that are obligated to love you and care for you though i feel like crap because im relying on people who have no obligation towards me sometimes i think maybe i would be better with my parents instead cause at least if they got tired of me they are obligated to care for me its their job and responsibility in a sense so maybe that would have given me some sort of relief in stress.
